Ellipse By Van Schooten

GeometryCirclesCurves
Game: This is a drawing to explore: two corners of a triangle slide along the arms of an angle, and you watch the path of the third corner.
How to play: Drag the blue dots, or focus one and use the arrow keys. Tick "Trace" to see the path, or "Show hint" to see the helper lines.
Look for the math

The surprising part is that a triangle whose corners only slide along two straight arms makes a curved path. Here is the chain of reasons, and what the logic test found when it checked them over hundreds of positions.

A circle with a fixed size

A and B sit on the two arms through O, so Thales' theorem gives AOB = 90°. The circle L through O, A and B then has diameter AB, so its radius is AB / 2. With "Define triangle" off, AB keeps its length, and the test found the same radius at every position it tried. This is the invariant that makes the rest work.

A rod sliding between two lines

Let M be the centre of L. The line MC meets L at P and Q, so PQ is a diameter and POQ = 90°: the test confirmed the dot product of OP and OQ is zero. Because the angles at A and B of the triangle stay fixed, P and Q keep to two fixed perpendicular lines through O. Point C is fixed on the rod PQ, exactly like the trammel of Archimedes. If u and v are C's coordinates along those two lines, then (u/a)² + (v/b)² = 1, so C traces an ellipse. The test checked this equation over 240 positions, allowing for P and Q swapping ends.

Where the half-axes come from

Since O is on L, OM = R, the circle's radius. P and Q are opposite ends of a diameter through M, so the distances from C to them are R + MC and |R − MC|; these are the half-axes the page states, and the test confirmed both. The page also says that with AB fixed C runs around a circular arc when O moves; that describes a different viewpoint from this applet's, where O is the fixed vertex and M stays one radius from O. One deliberate departure: the Java applet drops every other point onto the cursor when O is dragged, which wrecks the picture; here dragging O carries the whole configuration along instead.

Tick Trace and Define triangle, then drag C to change the triangle's shape: the traced curve changes too. Untick Define triangle to put the fixed AB back and watch the ellipse return.
